verdict.rationale: Windows documents public programming surfaces: the Windows App SDK and its current APIs, Win32 and C++/WinRT, Rust bindings via windows-rs, and Windows AI APIs. PowerShell is also documented as an official scripting interface, so the OS can be driven programmatically. However, the evidence frames these APIs mainly as tools for building apps rather than for automating or controlling Windows itself. Probes found no machine-readable API description (OpenAPI) or llms.txt. Missing for 10: evidence of documented OS automation/control APIs aimed at agents, machine-readable API specs, depth of API reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
